title: I Returned the Entitled Coupon With the Expiration Circled

parts.text: I was on register 3 at 11:20 when a man slapped down a coupon from 2019 and said I had to honor it because the store still existed. I was twenty-two. The coupon said EXPIRES 03/2019 in a font even he could have read. I circled the date with a spare marker, handed it back, and offered the current ad. He asked for a manager. The manager, who was me on Sundays, pointed at the circle. He left the candy. He did not leave the speech. I scanned the next person. The candy went back on the rack, unexpired. I keep the marker on a string now. Circles are a customer-service skill. Existence is not a barcode.

social.video_title: I circled 2019 and stayed the Sunday manager — Part 1/1
social.description: Register 3, a six-year-old coupon, a marker. He wanted the store's continued existence as a discount. Would you have called a different manager?
